query:
UPDATE cases 
SET departmentId = CASE 
  WHEN MOD(id, 10) IN (0,1,2,3) THEN 1  -- 40% Recursos Humanos
  WHEN MOD(id, 10) IN (4,5) THEN 2      -- 20% Tecnología
  WHEN MOD(id, 10) IN (6,7) THEN 3      -- 20% Finanzas
  WHEN MOD(id, 10) = 8 THEN 4           -- 10% Operaciones
  ELSE 5                                 -- 10% Ventas
END
WHERE departmentId IS NULL;
